mobamputation.config.prop.gibTime.name: Detached Part Lifetime
mobamputation.config.prop.blood.name: Blood
mobamputation.config.prop.gibTime.toolti: Maximum detached-limb lifetime in ticks. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Ticks a limb may rest on the ground before its 1-second fade.
mobamputation.config.prop.blood.tooltip: Show a blood burst when a body part detaches.
mobamputation.config.prop.bloodCount.too: Particles in each blood burst. Range: 1–1000.
mobamputation.config.prop.bloodSplurt.to: Make open wounds occasionally spray blood.
mobamputation.config.prop.greenBlood.too: Use yellow-green blood for non-player mobs. Players remain red.
mobamputation.config.prop.dynamicBloodSu: Let settled blood react to changing supports and let attached blood creep and release.
mobamputation.config.prop.bloodSurfaceDr: Let blood run down walls and entities, then drip from edges, ceilings, and undersides.
mobamputation.config.prop.bloodEntityCol: Blood collides with mobs, players, dropped items, and other solid entities. Some droplets stick and follow them.
mobamputation.config.prop.bloodSurfaceCh: Ticks between support checks and attached-blood movement. Range: 2–40; higher values update less often.
mobamputation.config.prop.playerGibs.too: Allow player heads and configured arms to detach. Your own parts stay invisible in first person; a detached head can drive the optional camera ride.
mobamputation.config.prop.gibPushing.too: Let detached parts collide with and push nearby entities.
Make a headless mob die after a short delay.
mobamputation.config.prop.projectileList: Per-projectile chance overrides. Entity IDs are recommended for modded projectiles.
mobamputation.config.prop.unlistedProjec: Severing chance (0–100%) for projectiles with no matching rule.
Chance (0–100%) for a fishing hook pull to sever a limb.
mobamputation.config.prop.allowProjectil: Allow projectiles without a matching rule to use the unlisted projectile chance.
mobamputation.config.prop.enchantmentsEn: Enable offensive bonuses on tagged tools. Beheading/Dismemberment add 20 points per level after armor; Severance adds 15. Server controlled.
mobamputation.config.prop.decapitationCa: In first person, follow your detached head. Fatal decapitation keeps the camera attached until death; changing perspective exits immediately.
mobamputation.config.prop.playerArmAmput: Allow either player arm to be severed. Empty hands and missing arms never delete inventory silently.
mobamputation.config.prop.fatalPlayerDec: A beheaded player bleeds briefly, then dies. A bandage cannot repair decapitation.
mobamputation.config.prop.armBleeding.to: Severed player arms cause finite real damage. One default wound costs five hearts over ten seconds.
mobamputation.config.prop.bandagesEnable: Let a bandage immediately close all active arm wounds. It does not restore an arm or cure decapitation.
mobamputation.config.prop.armBleedDurati: How long each arm wound bleeds. 20 ticks = 1 second.
mobamputation.config.prop.armBleedDamage: Damage units per arm and pulse, in tenths. 10 = 1 health point = half a heart.
mobamputation.config.prop.headBleedoutMi: Minimum delay before a decapitated player dies.
mobamputation.config.prop.headBleedoutMa: Maximum delay before a decapitated player dies.
mobamputation.config.prop.headBleedInter: Ticks between damage pulses while a player is decapitated.
mobamputation.config.prop.headBleedDamag: Damage per decapitation pulse, in tenths. Final decapitation remains fatal.
mobamputation.config.prop.bandageCooldow: Cooldown after successful bandage use. 20 ticks = 1 second.
mobamputation.config.prop.armorAmputatio: Reduce player amputation chance according to equipped armor and toughness.
mobamputation.config.prop.armorProtectio: Enable Reinforcement chance reduction and Anatomical Integrity immunity.
mobamputation.config.prop.armorGlobalRed: Relative chance reduction contributed by every armor point, including leggings and boots.
mobamputation.config.prop.armorCoveredRe: Extra relative reduction from the helmet for heads or chestplate for arms.
mobamputation.config.prop.armorToughness: Relative chance reduction contributed by each armor-toughness point.
mobamputation.config.prop.armorProtectio: Maximum reduction from ordinary armor before enchantment protection is added.
mobamputation.config.prop.reinforcementR: Additional relative reduction per Reinforcement level, capped with armor at 95%.
mobamputation.config.prop.anatomicalInte: Let Anatomical Integrity completely prevent amputation of the body part covered by that piece.
mobamputation.config.prop.creeperAmputat: Allow living Creepers' heads to detach.
mobamputation.config.prop.creeperGreenBl: Give Creepers thick, sticky green blood. When off, Creepers use the normal mob blood color.
mobamputation.config.prop.deathDismember: Disabled: no corpses split. Triggered: enabled explosions or iron golems. All: every supported mob death.
In Triggered mode, split supported mobs killed by explosions into body parts.
In Triggered mode, split supported mobs killed by an iron golem into body parts.
Maximum lifetime of body parts created when a mob dies. 20 ticks = 1 second.
How long a death body part may rest on the ground before fading. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Show a large blood burst when a supported corpse splits.
Particles in a normal death blood burst. Explosions create ten times as many. Range: 1–1000.
Use yellow-green blood for supported death bursts.
Let death-only body parts push nearby entities.

mobamputation.config.projectiles.title: Projectile Chance Overrides
mobamputation.config.projectiles.empty: No overrides. Damaging projectiles use the global fallback.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.add.too: Add a projectile override. Entity ID is the safest choice for modded projectiles.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.advance: Edit, import, or export the exact backing string without automatic cleanup.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.help.to: Entity ID is recommended. Legacy Name and Java Class are advanced compatibility options. Raw preserves exact text.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.help.li: Entity ID is recommended for modern and modded projectiles. Example: examplemod:bullet.
Custom sets a 0–100% sever chance. Excluded never severs. Default uses the unlisted projectile chance.
Legacy Name preserves old entries such as Arrow and Snowball.
Java Class rules may match more projectiles than expected. Use Entity ID unless a class rule is required.
Advanced Raw round-trips the exact backing string for developers. Nothing is reordered, deduplicated, or silently cleaned.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.type.to: Entity ID is recommended. Legacy Name and Java Class support advanced rules. Raw preserves exact text.
Enter namespace:path, a legacy name, a full Java class, or exact raw text according to Target Type.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.mode.to: Default uses the unlisted projectile chance; Custom uses this row's percent; Excluded never severs.
Sever chance for this projectile, from 0% through 100%.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.raw.war: This edits the exact rule string. Whitespace, duplicates, malformed entries, and Java-class rules can change behavior; nothing is cleaned automatically.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.raw.edi: Exact legacy-compatible rule string. Use [namespace:path]: chance for modern entity IDs.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.raw.app: Apply this raw string to the guided list. Done still saves the config.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.raw.exp: Copy the exact rule string to the clipboard.
mobamputation.config.projectiles.raw.imp: Replace the editor contents with clipboard text.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.add_item: Add an exact item ID such as minecraft:diamond_sword.
Add an item tag such as #minecraft:swords.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.advanced: Edit or paste the complete rule list as text.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.selector: Exact item ID: namespace:item. Exact items always override tags.
Item tag: #namespace:tag. When multiple tags match, the first matching tag row wins.
This row is malformed. Repair it here or in the raw editor.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.fallback: Any item not matched by an exact item or tag rule.
The fallback rule is required. Set its chance to 0 to disable other items.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.invalid: Fix the red rule before leaving this page.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.validati: Enter an item ID or item tag.
Use an exact ID in namespace:item form.
Enter a whole-number chance from 0 to 100.
Malformed rule. Repair it here or use the raw editor.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.raw.help: One rule per line: namespace:item=50, #namespace:tag=50, or *=0. Exact items override tags; the first matching tag wins.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.raw.edit: Edit one item, tag, or fallback rule per line.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.raw.appl: Apply this text and return to Tool Chances.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.raw.copy: Copy all rules to the clipboard.
mobamputation.config.tool_rules.raw.past: Replace the editor with clipboard text.
